title: Overfitting, regularization, and early stopping
summary: Choose a model checkpoint using validation behavior.

sections.title: Memorizing is not generalizing
paragraphs: A flexible model can keep reducing training error while becoming worse on unseen examples. This is overfitting. It is especially easy with few examples, noisy labels, or repeated tuning against a familiar evaluation set.

Regularization limits or discourages overly complex solutions. Examples include weight penalties, smaller models, data augmentation appropriate to the task, and early stopping. Each changes the trade-off and must be validated.

sections.title: Save the right checkpoint
paragraphs: Early stopping monitors a validation metric and retains the best observed parameter state. A patience setting allows a few non-improving steps before stopping. Save a copy of the weights, not a mutable reference that later updates will change.

The selected validation result is influenced by model choice and is therefore not an unbiased final estimate. Use a held-out test set after decisions are complete, and report uncertainty when the sample is small.

code.source:
training = [0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1]
validation = [0.9, 0.7, 0.5, 0.48, 0.53, 0.6]
best_epoch = min(range(len(validation)), key=validation.__getitem__)
print("Best checkpoint:", best_epoch + 1)
print("Training loss:", training[best_epoch])
print("Validation loss:", validation[best_epoch])
code.explanation: These are constructed learning curves, not training output from a real model. They isolate the checkpoint-selection decision.

steps: Reset a counter on improvement and increment it otherwise.
Stop after two consecutive non-improvements while retaining the best epoch.
practice.solution: The best checkpoint is epoch 4. Epochs 5 and 6 fail to improve, so training stops after epoch 6 with epoch 4 retained. The most recent weights are not necessarily the best weights.
practice.expected: The selected checkpoint is 4, with training loss 0.3 and validation loss 0.48.

quiz.question: Which checkpoint should be kept here?
options: The final one because its training loss is lowest
Epoch 4 because its validation loss is lowest
Whichever gives the highest test score after repeated attempts
quiz.explanation: Validation chooses the checkpoint. The final test set remains outside that selection loop.
